column1: # Countries the pipeline can ingest: one source of truth, read by both the Go
# build and the Makefile, so adding a country means editing one line here.
# The path is relative to https://download.geofabrik.de/ and the local filename
# is its last component plus -latest.osm.pbf. Sizes are indicative only; they
# come from the daily rebuild and drift.
# Codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 where one exists. Two are not exactly countries:
# gb is Geofabrik's great-britain, which excludes Northern Ireland, and ie is
# ireland-and-northern-ireland, which includes it — so gb+ie is the British
# Isles with no overlap and no gap. xk is the conventional user-assigned code
